## About
Classic Truck & Trailer Repair is a full service truck and trailer shop on 82nd Place in Justice, with easy highway access for drivers coming through the Chicago area and the surrounding suburbs. Whether you run one unit or a whole fleet, we are set up to handle the work.
The owner, Ed, knows trailers and reefers inside and out. A fleet customer wrote that he gets reefers fixed quickly and done right, and another reviewer said talking with him felt like learning from a professor.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 107 Google reviews. Call the shop, tell us what is going on with your truck or trailer, and we will get you back on the road.

## Services
- Air brake service: Valves, lines, chambers, shoes, drums, bushings and troubleshooting.
- Trailer refrigeration systems: Repair work on reefer units for single trailers and fleets.
- Welding: Minor fab work and repairs in steel and aluminum.
- Suspensions: Air bags, springs, bushings and equalizers.
- Driveline: Driveshafts, differentials and transmissions, in new, used and reman.
- Electrical: Troubleshooting and repair of harnesses.
- Engines: Drop ins, overhauls, racks, rods and mains, and troubleshooting.
- Service bay: Oil and filters changed, levels and belts checked, and grease.
- 90 day inspections: Truck and trailer inspections required by BIT, done every 90 days.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on single trucks or only fleets?
A: Both. We service fleets and single units alike.

Q: Do you do the 90 day BIT inspections?
A: Yes. We handle the 90 day truck and trailer inspections required by BIT.

Q: Can you fix my reefer unit?
A: Yes. Trailer refrigeration systems are part of the work we do, and a fleet customer wrote that Ed gets their reefers fixed quickly and done right.
